verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own documentation describes a public API that can be driven programmatically. It covers scoped Read/Write API keys, bearer-token authentication guidance written for AI agents, sandbox access to all products via the API, programmatic connected-account creation and transfers, and webhooks. The official CLI also exposes a broad slice of the API and lets users explore endpoints and schemas interactively, with agent-oriented MCP servers built on top. Missing for 10: a directly cited API reference or OpenAPI spec page, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
